title: Patient Payment Plan Offer Screening Term for Applicants
content:
**Rule.** A **Patient Payment Plan** offer that carries the tier's maximum term, the patient having asked for no shorter term, runs longer for an applicant up to the offer's screening term: 60 installments for a household screened at or below 200 percent of the federal poverty level and 48 installments for one screened above 200 and at or below 400 percent, each only on tiers whose maximum term is shorter; otherwise the screening term is the offer's number of monthly installments. When the offer is re-figured, such an offer is figured over the term the re-figure uses and booked with the term it books.

**Open application.** A financial assistance application of the patient is open when one of the patient's financial assistance cases in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) stands in submitted or pending documents status, a submitted case being taken first. The screening is the household federal poverty level (FPL) percentage on that application in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care).

| Tier | Tier maximum term | Offer at the maximum term, at or below 200% FPL | Offer at the maximum term, above 200% and at or below 400% FPL | Offer shorter than the maximum term, or otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 6 | 60 | 48 | the offer's own term |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 12 | 60 | 48 | the offer's own term |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 24 | 60 | 48 | the offer's own term |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 36 | 60 | 48 | the offer's own term |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 48 | 60 | 48 | the offer's own term |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 60 | 60 | 60 | the offer's own term |

**Hypothetical.** On a tier with a 24-installment maximum term, an offer at 24 installments for a household at 190 percent FPL has a screening term of 60; an offer at 18 installments for the same household keeps 18.
